about: Moods and broad genres for each song on John's Song of the Day. Each song gets up to two of ten moods, weighed up from Claude's picks (songs Claude knows, sound and lyrics), Last.fm listener tags, and Essentia's mood models listening to the 30-second preview (Music Technology Group, Universitat Pompeu Fabra, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). sound = the three moods the audio models hear most; listeners = whether Last.fm listeners' tags back the first mood; check = the voices disagree, or only the audio had anything to say. Genres come from MusicBrainz, Last.fm and Essentia's Discogs styles. John's corrections from the admin page always win.

agreement.about: For songs Claude knows: how often Last.fm listeners' three strongest moods, and the audio models' three strongest, include Claude's first pick.
